description: This file is a shell script that generates an SDK Repository XML based on input files, involving parsing command line arguments, extracting properties from ZIP archives, and constructing an XML document accordingly.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Outputs debug messages to standard error

methods.name: error
methods.description: Outputs error message and calls usage() to display usage info

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the script

methods.name: check_enum
methods.description: Checks if a value matches one of the expected enumeration values

methods.name: uses_new_host_os
methods.description: Determines if new host OS attributes are used based on schema version and root element

methods.name: parse_attributes
methods.description: Parses attributes from source properties or manifest files based on schema version

methods.name: output_attributes
methods.description: Outputs XML elements for attributes, possibly with special revisions
